evals.name: opencode-fragment-to-models-yml
evals.prompt: 我有一段不完整的 opencode provider 配置，想加进 oh-my-pi。baseURL 是 https://api.example-relay.test/v1，apiKey 用环境变量 EXAMPLE_RELAY_KEY（先别真的调网络），模型先配 gpt-5.4 和 gpt-5.4-mini。片段里只有名字和 limit（context 1050000/400000，output 128000），store:false，variants low/medium/high/xhigh。请按 omp 的方式写好 models.yml 里的 provider 段（合并进现有结构的示例即可），并从 models.dev 补全 cost/reasoning 等信息。不要用真实第三方域名发请求；网络只允许 models.dev。最后说明怎么 omp models / 冒烟。
evals.expected_output: A models.yml provider block with a dedicated id (not hijacking openai), openai-compatible api, supportsStore true, two models with context/maxTokens/cost/thinking from models.dev+fragment, and verification steps.
assertions: Uses a dedicated provider id instead of shadowing built-in openai
Sets apiKey to env name EXAMPLE_RELAY_KEY (not a literal secret)
Maps store:false to compat.supportsStore: true
Includes both gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini with fragment context/output limits
Fills cost fields from models.dev (non-zero plausible values)
Sets thinking efforts covering low/medium/high/xhigh
Documents omp models and smoke-test commands

evals.name: anthropic-proxy-with-strict-tools
evals.prompt: 帮我在 omp 里加一个 Anthropic 兼容中转：baseUrl https://claude-proxy.example.test/v1，key 环境变量 CLAUDE_PROXY_KEY，模型 claude-sonnet-4（context 200k，output 16k）。这是第三方代理。给出 models.yml 片段和需要注意的 disableStrictTools 等点，并说明为什么不要直接改 anthropic 内置 provider。
evals.expected_output: Separate provider id, api anthropic-messages, disableStrictTools true, authHeader, model entry, rationale for not shadowing built-in anthropic.
assertions: Uses a dedicated provider id, not built-in anthropic
Sets api: anthropic-messages
Sets disableStrictTools: true
Uses CLAUDE_PROXY_KEY as apiKey env reference
Model contextWindow 200000 and maxTokens 16384 (or 16k-equivalent)
Explains why not to override built-in anthropic provider

evals.name: responses-400-fallback
evals.prompt: 我已经把自定义 provider `broken-relay` 配成 api: openai-responses 了，但 omp 冒烟时报 400 Unsupported parameter: max_output_tokens，日志在讲 responses 请求。key 和 baseUrl 都对，chat/completions 用 curl 是好的。请按 omp-add-provider 的排障路径告诉我 models.yml 应该怎么改，并给出验证命令。
evals.expected_output: Diagnose Responses incompleteness, switch to openai-completions (or omit max tokens), mention reading http-400 dump, smoke test command.
assertions: Identifies max_output_tokens / incomplete Responses support as the cause
Recommends switching api to openai-completions (primary fix)
Mentions checking ~/.omp/logs/http-400-requests dump or equivalent
Provides a concrete smoke-test omp command
YAML snippet shows api: openai-completions for broken-relay

evals.name: linux-key-storage-no-keychain
evals.prompt: 我在 Ubuntu 服务器上用 omp（没有 GUI，也没有 macOS Keychain）。想加一个 OpenAI 兼容中转：baseUrl https://relay.example.test/v1，模型 gpt-5.4-mini（context 400000，output 128000）。key 我等下自己填。请给出 models.yml 片段，并说明 key 应该放哪、怎么让 omp 读到。
evals.expected_output: Provider block using an env var NAME for apiKey (no !security), the export line and where to put it, plus an optional !cat/pass alternative and verification commands.
assertions: Does NOT emit a !security / macOS Keychain recipe
Uses an env var name (e.g. RELAY_API_KEY) as apiKey
Shows the export line and where to place it (shell rc / systemd / environment.d)
Notes the env var must exist in the environment omp is launched from
Any alternative (pass / secret-tool / !cat) is gated on the tool being installed
Includes omp models and smoke-test verification commands
